name: Ricochet
summary: Ricochet measures low-energy reactor-neutrino recoils at ILL using cryogenic germanium detectors. Its heat-plus-ionization readout aims to distinguish nuclear recoils from dominant electromagnetic backgrounds and test CEvNS in the fully coherent regime.
detection_principle: Germanium crystals at millikelvin temperatures measure both phonons and ionization. The relative charge yield discriminates electronic from nuclear recoils; reactor cycles and layered shielding provide background control.
